categories.main_business_segments: HNAC Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy and environmental protection sectors, focusing on intelligent control hardware and software products and system solutions. Its main business segments include new energy equipment and systems (covering smart hydropower, photovoltaic, wind power, intelligent distribution, energy storage converters, integrated energy storage systems, and source-grid-load-storage integrated control platforms), lithium battery and materials intelligent equipment, and environmental protection products such as membranes and water treatment automation solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core intelligent control technologies, integrating IoT, big data, and AI to develop energy management systems, microgrid controllers, energy storage converters, and intelligent operation models. It has developed proprietary technologies like the first domestic AC excitation variable speed pumped storage system and advanced lithium battery formation and capacity sorting equipment. Production methods include order-based and planned manufacturing with a focus on customization and standardization for core products, supported by national-level R&D platforms and continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HNAC serves customers in the new energy sector including hydropower, photovoltaic, wind power, energy storage, and lithium battery manufacturers, as well as environmental protection clients in municipal and industrial water treatment. Its products and solutions cater to power stations, industrial parks, urban and rural water supply, and global markets including Africa, Southeast Asia, and Europe. Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers and national central enterprises in the energy sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with significant presence in regions such as Central China, South China, Southwest China, and overseas markets including over 70 countries in Africa (Ivory Coast, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Uganda), Southeast Asia (Cambodia, Thailand, Vietnam), and Europe. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Cambodia, Tanzania, Ethiopia, and other strategic locations to support international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: HNAC operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent control equipment and system solutions for new energy generation, storage, and environmental protection. It provides EPC services, system integration, and lifecycle management, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes market-driven innovation with a focus on intelligent control technologies, AI integration, and energy system optimization. Key R&D initiatives include upgrading integrated energy storage systems, developing high-voltage liquid-cooled PCS, advancing lithium battery formation and capacity sorting technologies, and creating intelligent operation models for hydropower and energy storage. It also prioritizes expanding international markets and enhancing operational efficiency through digital transformation and cost reduction.
categories.revenue_model: HNAC generates revenue mainly through direct sales of intelligent control hardware and software products, system integration projects, and EPC contracts. Revenue streams include product sales, engineering services, after-sales services, and leasing income from investment properties. The company also benefits from government subsidies and occasional investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HNAC holds a leading position in the global market for small and medium hydropower station automation control equipment and is recognized as a national manufacturing champion. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers of new energy equipment and lithium battery intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its strong R&D capabilities, broad product portfolio, and extensive global footprint provide competitive advantages in the rapidly evolving new energy and environmental sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, HNAC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.91 billion, a 19.39% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 393 million, reflecting intensified market competition and project delays. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 6.25 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.39 billion. Despite recent financial challenges, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D (about 8.75% of revenue) and pursues international market expansion to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HNAC differentiates itself through its deep expertise in intelligent control technologies and integrated energy solutions, offering comprehensive lifecycle services from design to operation. Its products feature advanced AI-driven predictive maintenance, high-precision control systems, and innovative energy storage management, enabling customers to optimize energy efficiency and reliability. The company’s strong brand reputation, national-level certifications, and strategic partnerships with leading lithium battery manufacturers further enhance its market position.
